page.overview:
What is Mega Lucario?

Lucario is a bipedal dog/wolf/jackal-like Pokémon, with a few raccoon-like characteristics as well. Though it is similar in appearance to Riolu, Lucario has some notable differences, such as having redder eyes. Its fore-paws are black and it has large pointed spikes in place of the oval shaped bumps on Riolu. There is also a third spike protruding in the middle of its chest. Lucario's ears and muzzle are longer in comparison to Riolu but it retains the black "mask" and red eyes. The "mask" also has an added upper stripe. It also has four black sensory bundles on the back of its head opposed to Riolu, who only had two and were previously located on the side of its head. Additionally, Lucario's torso is covered in yellow fur with thicker patches on the collar. When its mouth is open, four large canine teeth, two on the top and two on the bottom, can be seen.

Shiny Lucario replaces the slate-colored fur with a vibrant gold or yellow hue. The cream-colored torso and neck collar shift to a cool light-blue or cyan, while its black markings and red eyes remain unchanged.

Upon Mega Evolution, it has slimmer thighs, and longer yellow colored fur. Its paws become crimson and have grown more spikes. There are black markings on its blue fur due to its heightened aura. The sensory bundles also grown longer with two of them having crimson tips. Its eyes have changed from red to orange. Its tail is also merged with its cream yellow fur.

Mega Lucario Z has mostly dark, gunmetal grey for its thighs, head, ears, arms and tail, blue forearms, and its tail being split into two ends. It now has bright blue eyes shrouded in thick black outlines, and an array of silver circles and crescents. It also has two strands of long blue hair that trail from the back of its head, hanging past its shoulders with soft, jagged tips that flicker slightly when it charges aura. The usual head appendages fuse into two broader, heavier-looking shapes that extend down toward its knees, each marked with uneven silver seams that give them a forged, battle-worn feel. The cream fur along its torso grows fuller and shifts to one side, forming a slanted, windswept tuft rather than a neat point. More silver markings wrap around its waist and thighs in irregular bands, giving the impression of ancient symbols rather than clean stripes. Its chest spike reshapes into a rounded, shield-like plate with a flowing S-curve etched across it, and smaller matching plates appear on the backs of its hands, shins, and feet, which are smoother and more solid-looking like reinforced aura armor.
